positions.as_written: Examine at 20 to 30 degrees for this ligament and at 0 degrees for the posteromedial corner.
Expect healing in most isolated injuries.
Protect the infrapatellar branch of the saphenous nerve in any medial approach.
Treat valgus restraint as shared rather than solitary.
Assess rotation as well as valgus before calling a medial injury isolated.
Consider the healing position rather than only the healing.
Protect the dynamic coupling at the proximal tibial attachment where the tissue allows it.
